caption: The drawing presents a single object depicted in monochrome line art on a plain, lightly textured background. The object has a flat, roughly triangular base with rounded corners and a slightly pointed end; it is framed by a raised edge with three small circular indents on one visible side. The upper surface features three parallel, rectangular bars and one central wavy bar running horizontally across the base. Attached to one end of the object is a textured, turned wooden handle in a bulbous shape, with curved contours and a circular knob on the outermost end. The handle is fastened to the metal frame with visible joinery. The object rests on four short, outward-curving feet at the corners of the triangular base. The drawing is rendered in fine, evenly spaced lines, and the only colors present are the varying shades of gray from the pencil or ink, consistent with a simple, technical illustration style. In the bottom right corner of the image, the initials "B.W." are inscribed.
title: Flatiron Holder
